values.note: 2026: $34 a night for a utility site; primitive tent sites $26. Mid-week special Sunday-Thursday: four nights for the price of three ($102 utility). Early check-in or late check-out $17; dump station $15 for non-campers.

note: Carver County's 201-acre Baylor Regional Park on Eagle Lake near Norwood Young America, with a swim beach, fishing pier and the Eagle Lake Observatory. --Claude
